coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Sixteen attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: subject ba23f059 at 0444 unmoved, HEAD never left c353b00, file 08 at 3a9442d1 equal to the subject's own pin, governing tree clean. The load-bearing claim here is the fixture audit, and I reproduced it rather than reading it: v6 lists 51 authored fixtures, all 51 paths exist, and all 51 digests recompute to their pinned values, so the block's 51 / 51 / 0 is exactly right. Hashing files is not executing them, so that check stayed inside the dispatch constraint. Coverage is complete in both directions — the ten obligations partition cleanly across leftover, specified and discharged with no overlap and with the leftoverDesign flags matching the summary, and each of v6's five notAuthored categories maps to exactly one obligation, so nothing v6 declined to author is left unclassified. Every routing citation checks against primary bytes: ID-DEP-8 does send fixture generation and adapter conformance to DR-120 and DR-G15; OD-1's owner is UNASSIGNED between DR-115 and DR-120 in file 08's own words; unicode-norm-duplicate is BLOCKED on schemas.v11 pathRule / RJ-3 per v6; locks are deferred to DR-111 with retained bytes supporting and unscored; and the TC-SIG ceremony is discharged to DR-112 rather than named at G15. I checked the D-106 SATISFIED-GRADE citation specifically, because calling a candidate recording SATISFIED-GRADE would inflate it — D-106's own Decision type uses that exact phrase, so it is faithful, and D-013's SATISFIED-refusal is affirmed twice here as D-106 itself affirms it. Two DR-101 lessons were tested directly and both come out clean: the G15 owner is published under its own key and is byte-exact with the live cell rather than collapsed into DR-103's row owner, and the unauthored G15 harness specification is already marked leftover on D-056 gate 2 and Decision clause 5 rather than treated as an execution-only ride. One observation worth your attention, correctly handled by the artifact rather than being a finding: DR-103's live status cell still recites that no fixtures exist to run, which is now stale given 51 reproducing fixtures. The join flags it and routes the repair to a later MF-6 expressly without SATISFIED, editing nothing itself.
